nibbānābhirata.cp: adj. finding delight in nibbāna; fond of nibbāna.
nibbānābhirata.p: [Nibbāna+abhirata] (ti) CL=8 (1) Relishing at Nibbana. (2) Doing good deeds to attain Nibbana. (2) Relishing by building a place filled with good deeds to attain Nibbana.
